dynamic.body: A dynamic QR encodes a short redirect URL of your own whose destination you can change at any time without regenerating or reprinting the code. Every scan is recorded with country and device type for analytics. Full management via API with your same key.

rows.create: Creates a dynamic QR with a title and target URL; responds 201 with id, slug and redirectUrl
rows.list: Lists your dynamic QRs with their scan counts
rows.get: Detail of one, with aggregated analytics by country and device
rows.patch: Edits targetUrl and/or active (pause) without regenerating the code
rows.delete: Deletes the dynamic QR and its scan history

dynamic.note: The QR image is obtained from the generation endpoint by encoding the redirectUrl. Targets must be http(s).

intro.body: The QrAPI API generates QR codes with every editor style — gradients, dot shapes, custom corners, logos, background image and frames — and returns the image directly (PNG, SVG or JPEG), ready to use. It also manages dynamic QRs with analytics.

quickstart.body: From zero to your first QR in under a minute.
quickstart.step1Body: Sign up for free, go to Dashboard → API keys and generate a key. Copy it: it is shown only once.
quickstart.step2Body: Call GET /api/v1/qr with your key in the Authorization header and your content in the data parameter.
quickstart.step3Body: The response is the image itself. Pick png, svg or jpeg with the format parameter and the size with size.

auth.body: Every request requires an API key in the Authorization header. Create yours for free from the dashboard: sign up, go to API keys and generate one. The full key is shown only once.
auth.warning: Treat your key like a password: don't commit it to repositories or use it from the browser in production.

generate.getBody: For basic QRs, pass parameters in the query string. Great for quick testing.
generate.postBody: For gradients, custom corners, logos, background image and frames, send a JSON body. You can pass `data` (raw text) or `payload` (a typed object that builds the standard format for you: WiFi, vCard, email…).
generate.responseBody: The endpoint returns the image directly in the body, with no JSON envelope. Every response includes the rate limit headers; a 429 adds Retry-After in seconds.

params.postNote: The body must include exactly one of data or payload. Rows typed object expand to show their subfields.
params.name: Parameter

rows.payload: Typed object alternative to data: it builds the standard format for you (WiFi, vCard, email…)
rows.payloadType: Payload type; each type adds its own fields (ssid, phone, address…)
rows.size: Width in pixels (64–2048). Ignored for svg
rows.ecLevel: Error correction: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%)
rows.cornersSquareStyle: Style of the 3 positioning corner frames
rows.frameStyle: Adds a decorative frame with the given style
rows.frameTextColor: Frame text hex color; contrast is computed automatically when omitted
rows.style: Full style object; expand it to see the subfields
rows.styleDots: Shape (style), hex color and optional gradient of the dots
rows.styleCornersSquare: Style, color and gradient of the corner frames; inherits dots.color when omitted
rows.styleCornersDot: Style, color and gradient of the corner centers
rows.styleBackground: Background: color, transparent, optional gradient and image (background image)
rows.gradientShape: Gradient: type linear or radial, rotation 0–360 and stops with 2–4 entries of offset 0–1 and hex color
rows.logo: Logo centered over the QR; raise ecLevel for large logos
rows.logoDataUri: Base64 data URI of the logo (png, jpeg, svg or webp, max ~500 KB)
rows.logoSizeRatio: Logo size as a ratio of the QR width (0.1–0.35)
rows.backgroundImage: Background image behind the QR: dataUri (png/jpeg/webp), contrast scrim opacity and corner plate tint. Forces error correction H
rows.frame: Decorative frame with text; expand it to see the subfields
rows.frameTextColorSub: Text color; automatic contrast when omitted
rows.framePositionSub: Band at the bottom or the top
rows.effects: Global effects; expand it to see the subfields

errors.body: Errors are returned as JSON with this shape:

rows.invalid_params: Invalid query parameters (the details field tells you which)
rows.data_too_long: The content does not fit in a QR at that correction level
rows.limit_reached: You reached the maximum of 100 dynamic QRs per account
rows.not_found: The dynamic QR does not exist or does not belong to your key

rateLimits.body: Each API key has these limits, shared across all endpoints.

headers.limit: Limit of the current minute window
headers.reset: Epoch in seconds when the window resets
headers.retryAfter: 429 only: seconds to wait before retrying
